newsitem.title: USA: U S West in marketing deal with Rockies.
newsitem.headline: U S West in marketing deal with Rockies.

text.p: U S West said on Friday it will be the official telecommunications sponsor of the Colorado Rockies major league baseball team.
Terms of the marketing agreement were not disclosed.
Denver-based U S West operates in a 14-state region in the West, including the Rocky Mountain states.
The regional bell company had been associated with the Rockies before with various events, but never had anything on a long-term basis, it said.
The agreement provides for advertising, marketing and promotional opportunities, U S West said. A large U S West sign will be installed inside Coors Field.
